subject: Vireo: security-driven hosting tradeoffs and evidence roadmap
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jane Alvarez <jane.alvarez@vireohealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vireo: security-driven hosting tradeoffs and evidence roadmap

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed set of next steps so we can land on the right hosting path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem):

Summary of Vireo constraints we heard
- PHI in payloads (ePHI) — required BAA
- Need for annual audit evidence (SOC 2 Type II preferred) and access to logs for 3 years
- KMS/HSM integration requirement for key separation
- Preferred region: us-east-1; no cross-border processing
- Pen test results and network segmentation documentation requested before production go-live

High-level tradeoffs (from the call)
- Hosted API: fastest to integrate (low engineering lift). Requires signed BAA + limited evidence package (SOC 2 report). Good if you accept logical multi-tenant with strict contractual controls.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools; better isolation and predictable performance; supports customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest but still controlled by Redwood infra.
- Private VPC / on-prem: maximum control (VPC peering or on-prem appliance), supports customer-managed keys, audit log forwarding, and can meet strict regulatory controls — longer lead time and higher operating cost.

Immediate asks / action items
1) From Redwood (we) — share SOC 2 evidence package (redacted) and a short infra diagram showing where keys & logs live.
2) From Vireo — confirm whether a signed BAA is acceptable as sole contractual control for Hosted, or whether you require a Private deployment.
3) Technical deep-dive — schedule a 60-minute session with Aditya to go over KMS integration and network requirements (can we do Wed or Thu this week?).
4) Legal redlines — send the BAA draft to your counsel; Marissa will follow up on any vendor-side notes.

Attachments: BAA_draft_v2.pdf (pdf), SOC2-scope-summary.xlsx (excel)

Proposed timeline (if Hosted acceptable):
- Day 0–3: sign BAA + exchange of minimal questionnaires
- Day 3–7: share SOC2 redacted report & infra diagram
- Day 7–14: POC (sandbox) with sample ePHI flows; pen test scheduling concurrently

Please confirm which option you want prioritized and whether Wed/Thu this week works for the technical deep-dive.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: BAA_draft_v2.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: SOC2-scope-summary.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Vireo: security-driven hosting tradeoffs and evidence roadmap

Thanks Kim & Jane — adding a bit more technical color so Vireo can evaluate the three hosting options against your security asks.

Technical notes (high level):
- Hosted API
  - Data-in-transit encrypted with TLS 1.3; customer keys are not used for model weights but we support TLS client certs and strict egress control.
  - Access logs available via secure S3 export; retention configurable up to 3 years.
  - KMS: we offer envelope encryption with our keys by default; for Hosted we can offer limited BYOK via a hosted HSM proxy (requires contract & configuration).

- Dedicated capacity
  - Single-tenant GPU pools surfaced as logically isolated nodes; supports customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest and separation of duties.
  - Network ACLs + VPC peering available to restrict traffic.
  - Good middle ground if you want lower time-to-value but stronger isolation than pure Hosted.

- Private VPC / On-prem
  - Full control over networking, routing, and key material; audit logs can be forwarded to your SIEM (Splunk/Datadog).
  - Longer provisioning (3–8 weeks depending on region & approvals).

Proof / evidence we can provide quickly:
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (controls mapping) — typically within 24–48 hours after NDA/BAA.
- Infrastructure diagram and network segmentation (attached).
- KMS integration notes + sample policies.

Risks / blockers to call out now:
- If Vireo requires HSM-in-customer-VPC for production keys, Private VPC or on-prem will likely be required.
- Pen test windows need to be scheduled in advance; we can provide a scope template to speed approvals.

I can meet for the technical deep-dive on Thu 11:00–12:00 PST or Fri 09:00–10:00 PST. Jane, which works for you?

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: infra_diagram.png (png)]

Kimberly, Aditya, Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers from our side:
- We prefer Hosted API initially for speed, but we must see a signed BAA + a redacted SOC 2 Type II before we ingest any ePHI into the environment.
- If the SOC 2 report does not contain required controls (especially around KMS separation and audit log retention), we'll escalate to Dedicated or Private.
- We will run the vendor questionnaire this week and send it back by EOD Friday; I also attached a short priority list: 1) SOC2 reporting & scope 2) KMS / key separation 3) Audit log access 4) Pen test timing.

Can you confirm: once we sign BAA, how soon can we receive the redacted SOC2 and the infra diagram? Also please send the vendor questionnaire link (or we can upload to the Drive folder you shared).

Regards,
Jane Alvarez
